inputs.subject: 2024 Tax Preparation: Deductions, Home Office, and Forms
inputs.body:
Here is a breakdown of your 2024 tax situation based on the details provided:

1. Standard vs. Itemized Deductions
For 2024, the Standard Deduction for Married Filing Jointly is $29,200. 
Looking at your potential itemized deductions:
- Charitable contributions: $1,100
- Unreimbursed employee expenses: $950 (Note: Under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, unreimbursed W-2 employee expenses are no longer deductible federally).
Since your total itemized deductions ($1,100) are far below $29,200, you should definitely take the Standard Deduction.

2. Above-the-Line Deductions (Adjustments to Income)
Even if you take the standard deduction, you can claim these:
- Student Loan Interest: You paid $4,250, but the IRS caps this deduction at $2,500 per return (subject to MAGI phase-outs, though your combined income appears to be within the deductible range). 

3. Home Office Treatment
You can deduct home office expenses against your self-employment (web design) income, but NOT your W-2 income. 
- Space: 110 sq ft / 680 sq ft = ~16.18% of your home.
- Actual Expenses Method: You can deduct 16.18% of your rent ($1,600/mo = $19,200/yr * 16.18% = ~$3,106), plus 16.18% of utilities and internet.
- Simplified Method: 110 sq ft x $5/sq ft = $550 deduction. 
The Actual Expenses method will yield a much higher deduction for you, though it requires more record-keeping.

4. Forms You Will Need
- Form 1040: The main tax return.
- Schedule 1: To report your business income and claim the student loan interest deduction.
- Schedule 2: To report self-employment tax on your web design income.
- Schedule B: Because your interest and dividends ($2,340 + $440 = $2,780) exceed the $1,500 threshold.
- Schedule C: To report your $11,200 web design income and deduct your business expenses.
- Schedule SE: To calculate self-employment tax on your net web design income.
- Form 8829: If you choose the Actual Expenses method for your home office deduction.

Disclaimer: I am an AI assistant, not a CPA. It is always recommended to use tax software or consult a tax professional to ensure accuracy and maximize your return!
